headline.text: L2 ML2 lost most of first shift to *belt and printer* failures on 12g changeover — running by afternoon but unstable

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran smoothly with routine maintenance. S3 paused 47 minutes for a belt rubbing issue (cleared and ATP-passed). S2 and S1 both had minor heavy-cream leaks repaired. S4 cooked one-shot all day, viscosity within spec after a low first batch.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 down most of first shift — long belts faulting, printer wouldn't hold settings, belt tracking failures. Switched printers twice, powered down entire line at 11:14. Running by early afternoon but saw quality issues (doubles/triples). ML3 and FFS ran well after brief startups.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ran production across three lines. Truffle had M4 sensor rejections in the morning (cleared), separator belt replaced during Bites changeover. ML4 had recurring vibration and TG faults throughout the day. ML1 started late due to tempering issues and Cavanna registration problems that persisted through shift end.

notes.text: Troy Baxter reminded teams to follow proper printer shutdown procedure after MM9 printer was powered down incorrectly.
Joey Dudney reported 102 Hershey PECO pallets left; delivery scheduled for tomorrow.
Chad Stone asked teams not to push pallets into tarp near emergency exit; Benjamin Hicks requested clear floor marking.

resolved.title: S2 heavy cream transfer pump leak
resolved.summary: Water leak in heavy cream transfer pump; QA tested samples and water activity to verify no contamination.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 11:38 — maintenance replaced pipe assembly with pressure-regulating valve; QA confirmed water activity in spec (Marcos Jimenez, Mary Montilla).

resolved.title: S3 cross conveyor belt rubbing on cover
resolved.summary: Belt rubbing against metal cover with debris visible on floor; paused line for food-safety inspection.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:36 — "QA verified the conveyor belt. No product was affected. We will clean the belt" and ATP passed; line restarted (Karla Uribe).

resolved.title: S4 first one-shot batch viscosity out of spec
resolved.summary: First batch viscosity 9,050 vs. minimum 9,860; cooked second batch to verify process.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:46 — second batch viscosity 16,480, within target; "We will continue running continuously" (Marcos Jimenez).

resolved.title: S1 heavy cream pipe leak
resolved.summary: One of the heavy cream pipes leaking; maintenance called to inspect.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:24 — "The service module has been replaced" (Chris Jeffs).

resolved.title: FFS gusset fold and tracking issues on changeover
resolved.summary: Creating tube but tracking off; gusset folds not right after changeover to snack size.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 11:04 — tracking figured out, gusset good, x-ray recipe located; "We are running" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: ML3 ramp belt issue
resolved.summary: Line down due to issues with ramp belt.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:46 — "Line running again, we cleaned the area and restarted the belt" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: FFS sensor fault after startup
resolved.summary: Sensor fault after line started running; making adjustments.

resolved.title: Guillotine belt misalignment at line start
resolved.summary: Belt tracking required adjustment before production could begin; maintenance cleared it while other startup tasks continued.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:07 — "Guillotine outfeed belt has been aligned and is working as it should now" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: M4 belt misalignment causing sensor rejections
resolved.summary: Product not aligning at M4, sensor rejecting bars; four employees manually aligning while maintenance adjusted tracking.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 09:23 — Grey Boscan: "That issue has been fixed, but now Maintenance is working on Cavanna 1."

resolved.title: ML4 horizontal vibrator faulting, stopping line
resolved.summary: Vibrator table 1 horizontal faulting out and stopping WDS repeatedly at startup.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 07:07 — Nelson Cook lowered horizontal to 20 Hz and it stopped faulting.

resolved.title: Separator table belt damaged and breaking
resolved.summary: Belt starting to break, uncertain how long it would last; replacement available and line planning changeover.
resolved.resolution: Replaced during planned changeover — "Separator belt has been changed and the Cavanna changeover is now complete" at 13:56 (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: M5 belt stopped running after speed adjustment
resolved.summary: Belt speed adjusted from 13 to 9, which caused it to stop; line lead called maintenance.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:52 — "The speed of the M5 belt was adjusted, which caused it to stop running; maintenance has reduced the speed" (Bojana McLeod).

resolved.title: Cavanna 2 printer time not updated for DST
resolved.summary: Time on Cavanna 2 not set to new schedule; maintenance called.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:05 — "The time on the Cavanna 2 printer has been adjusted" (TruffleLine FW).

needs_attention.title: S4 Sucrotherm temperature fault
needs_attention.summary: Sucrotherm showing a temperature fault during one-shot production; Chris Jeffs notified.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 09:10. No update on resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML2 long belts and printer failures on 12g changeover
needs_attention.summary: Line down most of first shift with long belt faults, speed belt tracking issues, and printers (inkjet then laser then inkjet again) unable to hold settings or fit print in box.
needs_attention.status: Running as of 13:12 at reduced speed (10mpm filler, 700ppm TG) after encoder swap on inkjet printer. Long belts still intermittently faulting; last report at 13:15 of line down again. Alan Todd reported at 15:14 the line has been "up and down" working through blow-offs at TG entrance.

needs_attention.title: ML2 double and triple pieces in product
needs_attention.summary: Many double and triple pieces observed; product being inspected to remove affected parts.
needs_attention.status: Ongoing inspection as of 13:47. Alex Mendoza and Justin Halladay asked to come look.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 and vibration faults recurring all day
needs_attention.summary: TG5 blowing off bars, shutting down repeatedly; vibration faults causing WDS stops even after frequency adjustment.
needs_attention.status: Intermittent throughout the day. WDS paused at 10:23 for TG belt running very slow, back up after 10 minutes. TG5 and vibration issues mentioned at 06:43, 08:29, and 10:08. Technicians working on it but no final resolution reported by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 product appearance — bars with chocolate exposure
needs_attention.summary: Some bars coming out of gondola broken or with visible exposure; technician working on adjustments.
needs_attention.status: Appearance improved by 10:27 and is "within the standards" but update at 13:32 shows pieces with exposure still visible in smaller amounts. Leaders and technicians informed.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Cavanna registration shifting on film change
needs_attention.summary: Each time flow-wrap film roll changed, machine gets out of adjustment causing excessive silver exposure on bars.
needs_attention.status: Ongoing at shift end. Grey Boscan at 14:22 confirmed "the issue has not been resolved yet" and added action to follow up with second-shift maintenance. Shawn Jewkes clarified it's silver exposure, not position of ends.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix date printer not fitting in designated spot
needs_attention.summary: Date setup on pouch not fitting in desired spot after assorted changeover; operators and maintenance troubleshooting.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance still troubleshooting as of 07:30. No resolution reported by window close at 15:19.

needs_attention.title: ML1 glycol level low
needs_attention.summary: Glycol level reported low on system.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 14:19. No follow-up action or resolution noted by window close.
